values.note: 2026/2027 rates: summer (June 1 - Oct 31) $100/night, monthly $1,950; winter (Nov 1 - May 31) $120/day, monthly $2,450 Nov-Dec and $3,600 Jan-Mar. All sites include water, sewer and electric. Plus 6.5% sales tax and 5% Lee County tourism tax. All sales final, no refunds.

values.note: Text your name, dates and RV size/type to 239-676-3880; they reply if/when a site is free. A specific site can't be guaranteed.
